skills.noVersions: No version history for this skill.
skills.observedSince: First observed invocation: {{date}}. Earlier use cannot be inferred.
skills.noObserved: No explicit invocations recorded. Earlier use is unknown.
skills.noComparison: A second version is needed for comparison.
skills.comparisonCaveat: Based on explicit invocations. Differences across versions are observational, not evidence that the skill caused a change; at least five measured runs on each side are required to show a difference.
skills.perplexitySamePrompt: Perplexity is scored per prompt version and both groups read the same prompt, so the difference is not comparable.
skills.useControlCaveat: The control group holds terminal runs by the same roles on the same project that never invoked the skill inside the instrumentation window. Deltas appear only when both sides have at least 5 samples.
skills.noVersionEvents: No version events yet (the first version is not an event).
skills.observational: Invocation counts are observed calls, not measured skill outcomes.
skills.restoreConfirm: Restore v{{version}} as v{{next}}? Assignments remain unchanged.
skills.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can restore versions.
skills.catalogSelectableHint: Selectable rows are skills already imported into this workspace. Runtime and plugin discoveries below are visible but not selectable until imported.
skills.catalogNoMatch: No discovered skills match the current search or source filter.
skills.discoveryImportedToast: Skill imported. It is now selectable with its own version history.
skills.discoveryImportFailedToast: Import failed. Check the runtime connection and try again.

quality.since: Measured from {{date}}. Runs before that date carry no instrumentation and are not counted.

noSubject.title: Pick a subject
noSubject.description: The seven dimensions are read per prompt tier. Choose an agent to load its dashboard.

timeline.title: Versions
timeline.empty: No version carries measured runs in this window.

compare.title: Version comparison
compare.description: Seven dimensions, side by side. A dimension with no data on either side shows no delta.

injected_tokens.label: D1 Injected cost
injected_tokens.hint: Median tokens of assembled prompt injected per run.

run_tokens_median.label: D1 Run cost
run_tokens_median.hint: Median total tokens a run consumed.

discipline.label: D2 Discipline
discipline.hint: Median discipline score out of 100. A run starts at 100 and loses points for each mechanically checkable clause it broke.

tool_failure_rate.label: D4 Turn failure rate
tool_failure_rate.hint: Share of tool results the agent received as errors.

retry_rate.label: D5 Retries
retry_rate.hint: Share of runs that needed more than one attempt.

failure_attribution.label: D6 Prompt-attributed failures
failure_attribution.hint: How many failures had a cause pointing at the prompt. Environment and provider failures are not counted.

first_pass_rate.label: D7 First-pass rate
first_pass_rate.hint: Share of reviewed issues accepted without rework.

measure.excluded: {{count}} excluded as environment or provider failures

reason.no_finished_runs: No run finished in this window.
reason.not_instrumented: Runs in this window predate the instrumentation.
reason.no_covered_runs: No run in this window carried this measurement.
reason.no_version_content: This version has no recorded prompt body.
reason.no_reviewed_issues: No issue reached review in this window.
reason.below_sample_floor: Fewer runs than the declared floor.
reason.unknown: The server did not say why.

perplexity.title: D3 Rule perplexity
perplexity.description: An ambiguity score for the assembled prompt, judged per runtime profile.
perplexity.profileNote: Profiles are scored against different assembled documents and are never merged or averaged.
perplexity.reproducibility: Re-scoring the same version keeps the band stable; the interval endpoints were measured to move by no more than 10 percentage points (gpt-6-luna, temperature 0.2, 5 runs per runtime profile).

empty.title: Not scored
empty.description: No version of this prompt has been scored yet. A missing score is not a neutral score.

sheet.title: D3 evidence
sheet.description: Seven sub-dimensions, each with its own weight and the locations it cites.
sheet.noEvidence: No session-log evidence for this entry (runtime offline).

reasons.title: D6 Failure reasons
reasons.empty: No failed run in this window.

quiz.noSubject: The reading is per prompt tier. Choose an agent to load its quiz history.

reading.title: Regression reading
reading.description: One fixed question bank replayed against every prompt version. The reading is a distribution, not a single score.
reading.noVersion: This prompt has no recorded version, so nothing has been measured.
reading.accumulating: v{{version}} has {{have}} of {{need}} usable readings. No comparison until the group is complete.
reading.noBaseline: v{{version}} is measured over {{count}} runs (median {{median}}, IQR {{iqr}}), and is the first version of this prompt — there is no earlier version to compare against. It becomes the baseline for the next one.
reading.versions: v{{baseline}} as baseline, v{{current}} as the version under reading.
reading.outcomes: {{answered}} runs produced an answer, {{errored}} errored. Neither count is a score: nothing grades what an answer said.
reading.incomparable: {{count}} readings are excluded from this group: they were taken at another question wording, or on another runtime or model.
reading.baselineIncomparable: {{count}} readings are excluded from the baseline group for the same reason.
reading.notAGate: A quiz never blocks a prompt version from being published. It records how the quality changed.

bank.title: Question bank
bank.description: The same questions for every version. Editing a body starts a new revision.

empty.title: No questions yet
empty.description: Without questions no version can be measured. Add one to start the first reading.

dialog.description: A question must not name any production entity — no issue key, no id, no link. The server refuses a body that does and says which reference to remove.
dialog.bodyHint: Up to 4000 characters. Keep it self-contained: a quiz run has no issue behind it.
dialog.rubricHint: Owner-only, and never sent to the run being measured. Saving replaces the stored answer key with whatever this field holds.

bank.importError: The benchmark bank was not imported.

graded.title: Grading
graded.description: Checks each collected run's answer against the item's answer key, assertion by assertion, with per-check evidence.
graded.refused: {{count}} agent(s) were refused; the rest were ordered
graded.samplesEmpty: No graded samples yet. Run one grading batch; per-check evidence appears here once the runs finish.
graded.notAGate: Grading is a reading, not a gate: no publish path reads it.

legislation.title: Prompt legislation proposals
legislation.description: Clause-level drafts for the four prompt carriers. Submitting sends a proposal to the workspace owner; approval runs the legislation gate and enacts only on a clean pass.
legislation.createDescription: A draft needs the content-gate five answers before it can be submitted — keep each answer concrete.
legislation.clauseTextPlaceholder: The exact clause text to enact; empty for a removal.
legislation.gateLayerPlaceholder: Which instruction tier this clause belongs to.
legislation.gateCostPlaceholder: What every run carrying it pays.
legislation.gateConflictPlaceholder: Which existing clause it touches or replaces.
legislation.gateDedupPlaceholder: Why it is not a duplicate of an existing clause.
legislation.previewDescription: Approving synthesizes the whole carrier in a sandbox and runs the legislation gate. Review the diff below — approval is refused without the explicit confirmation.
legislation.confirmPreviewed: I have reviewed the full-text diff
legislation.selectHint: Select pending proposals to approve in one pass (max 20).
legislation.enactHint: Re-runs the gate; enacts only on a clean pass.
legislation.rejectPlaceholder: Why this proposal is rejected — the reason stays on the record.
legislation.emptyHint: Draft one from real execution evidence, or let the daily retrospective propose.
legislation.error: The write failed. Check your inputs and retry.
legislation.batchPartial: Some proposals in the batch did not enact — check the per-item results.
legislation.jevDisclaimer: Low-cost advisory only — read it together with its probability basis; never a disposition basis on its own (warn-only sidecar, gate verdicts unaffected).

retrospective.title: Daily retrospective
retrospective.description: A built-in scheduler reads the real execution content of completed issues inside the window, distills prompt improvement drafts and drops them into the legislation pool. Runs never post issue comments.
retrospective.llmUnavailable: The LLM is not configured — a run records a failed entry naming the missing configuration.

knowledge.title: Knowledge library
knowledge.description: bd memories directories are discovered automatically from connected projects or added manually below; entries mirror read-only, and adoption transfers them into the knowledge hub in the background.
knowledge.registerDescription: Registers the path as a manually added source; the first read-only scan runs in the background. The knowledge hub is designated separately and is not registered here.
knowledge.advancedDescription: Point at a bd memories directory on this machine. Label is optional.

emptyDirs.title: No registered directories
emptyDirs.description: Sources appear here automatically when a connected daemon discovers a project with bd memories; you can also add one manually under Advanced below.

knowledge.emptyEntries: No entries under the current filter.
knowledge.ownerOnly: Registering, scanning, unregistering and adopting are workspace-owner only.

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: Every effective change appends a version; history is never rewritten.
versions.bindingNote: Quality evaluation binds each run to the version it claimed. The badge shows how many runs each version served.
versions.snapshotBody: A snapshot records the carrier's currently effective configuration as a new version. The carrier's own content is not changed.
versions.emptyDescription: Snapshot the first version from this carrier's currently effective content.
versions.activateBody: Activating appends a new version with this content and makes it effective. History is never rewritten.
versions.secretBlocked: Not saved: the prompt appears to contain credentials.
